decision: Only KDE Firefox may project a fresh independently read complete native field back to its already-current owned-preedit external boundary. Preserve the current witness across the adjacent actual observation, including a held local key, while retaining the existing manual held-key prohibition. Do not restore a stale or missing witness, issue KnownStart, install native edit binding or create a delivery route.
reason: Native rows show Firefox reporting one trailing character then empty surrounding text during owned-preedit Backspace, and a full first word with a lagging caret during managed insertion. Both invalidate the current boundary before a reverse Double Shift or later Tab. The existing generic observation carry also depends on manual input-release retirement, although observation preservation itself grants no edit authority.
verification: Pure projection tests bind complete native text and exact unselected caret to the current owner, witness, layout, epoch and existing external prefix/suffix. Fail closed for stale/missing proof, foreign prefix or suffix, different token, selection, privacy, atomic operation, focus/lease/layout/epoch/revision changes. A held key can preserve read evidence but must still forbid manual toggle. Source RED/GREEN, complete affected IME lane, warning-free release, exact loaded bytes, then short causal controls before longer series and window modes. Preserve every prior failure receipt.
not_tested: Rejected before build/install: a fresh AT-SPI field alone cannot bind an older owned preedit to the same native field. Unbuilt source experiment archived outside the checkout and removed. No runtime change from this proposal.
